tree-checker
column2: running fsstress leads to tree-checker warning at write time

column1: as we created file extent items with an invalid ram_bytes.
All those offending file extents have offset 0
num_bytes
This would also trigger the recently enhanced btrfs-check
such mismatches and report them as minor errors.
[CAUSE]
When a folio/page is invalidated and it is part of a submitted OE
mark the OE truncated just to the beginning of the folio/page.
And for truncated OE
column2: we insert the file extent item with incorrect

column1: value for ram_bytes (using num_bytes instead of the usual value).
This is not a big deal for end users
column2: as we do not utilize the ram_bytes

column1: field for regular non-compressed extents.

[FIX]
